subject.title: fix(talk): reject malformed relay audio base64

question: Should talk.session.appendAudio now fail closed for every input outside canonical standard or URL-safe base64, even though the shipped Node decoder tolerated additional malformed forms?
rationale: The implementation is technically sound, but repository policy treats stricter validation on a public Gateway RPC as an upgrade-sensitive compatibility choice that code review cannot infer safely.

options.title: Accept strict relay contract
options.body: Approve canonical standard/base64url as the supported input set and allow malformed legacy forms to fail with a clear RPC error.

options.title: Preserve broader legacy acceptance
options.body: Require a specifically documented and tested compatibility set beyond canonical standard/base64url before enabling fail-closed validation.

recommendation.title: Accept strict relay contract
recommendation.body: Approve canonical standard/base64url as the supported input set and allow malformed legacy forms to fail with a clear RPC error.

likelyOwner.reason: The browser realtime Talk and Gateway relay path traces to this person's feature work, making them the best available owner for the RPC compatibility decision.
